from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-f952d388.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]\n    if len(points) < 3:\n        return out\n    (r0, c0), (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = points[-3:]\n    dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1\n    if dr == r1 - r0 and dc == c1 - c0 and (dr or dc):\n        r, c = r2 + dr, c2 + dc\n        while 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]):\n            if out[r][c] == 0:\n                out[r][c] = 2\n            r += dr\n            c += dc\n    return out\n'''
program_path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_f952d388', program_path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
demo=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(1,1),(3,3),(5,5)]: demo[r][c]=1
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r,c in [(7,7),(9,9),(11,11),(13,13)]: expected[r][c]=2
print('demo reproduces:', mod.transform(demo)==expected)
test=[[0]*15 for _ in range(15)]
for r,c in [(0,0),(3,3),(6,6)]: test[r][c]=1
answer=mod.transform(test)
print(answer)
